the pulsation spectra of V 588 Mon (PMS star with T _{eff} ~ 4000 K, log g~4.0) and V 589 (PMS star, T _{eff} = 5000-6000 K, log(g)~4.0-3.5) are very similar, and that the frequencies of the two stars are very similar to those of the more evolved δ Sct stars.
